data.description: Creatures damaged by either the slam attack or the death throes must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or contract blinding sickness. Blinding Sickness - Injury;  save  Fort DC 16;  onset   1d3 days;  frequency  1/day;  effect  1d4 Str damage, if more than 2 Str damage, target must make an additional Fort save or be permanently blinded;  cure  2 consecutive saves.
data.name: Disease (Blinding Sickness)
